observations: A single new live held-out forecast needs an unchanged Execute baseline so holder/predictor independence, pre-retrieval commitments, reveal ordering, and deterministic scoring remain attributable to the validated gate rather than a Candidate overlay.

Existing live-campaign, context-hygiene, benchmark, and retrieval Candidates are not verified for this exact independent-holder/predictor clean_g1 scope and cannot substitute for externally checkable isolation receipts; absence of either surface must produce NOT_EVALUABLE before retrieval.
